verdict.rationale: Typesense documents an official Typesense Cloud MCP server that lets an AI agent create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search, and read metrics from the conversation, with user-scoped permissions on connect. This covers index operations and metrics/analytics, and the docs position Typesense explicitly for AI agents. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that agents can run search queries through the MCP tools, evidence of an MCP or tool surface for self-hosted (non-Cloud) deployments, detailed tool reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
